b:
I want to talk literature,
I want harmony,
I want agreement

A quiet smile
as we admire the deep sea,
a calm boat ride
on the bank of a blue river

The sunrise,
silent nights,
the artistry
of stone temples

Ponniyin Selvan,
the novel
and history,
Dravidianism
and Tamil
and devotion

For all of it I want her

When I lean on her lap
and get soaked
in the rain of her hair,
she
is the umbrella

She,

like Tamil
and nectar,
so that we may live
in the shade of one umbrella
note: Ponniyin Selvan is Kalki Krishnamurthy's much-loved historical novel about the Chola kings.
